title: Tropical Fruit Hunting Tour at Grimal Grove
blurb:
Visit the only Breadfruit Grove in Continental United States!

While here, discover the rich history of Grimal Grove and its legendary founder, Adolf Grimal, on a 75–90-minute tropical fruit hunting tour. This engaging experience takes you through the grove where you'll learn about its 70+ year journey of restoration and resilience. Depending on the season, guests may even have the chance to pick ripe fruits directly from the trees. The tour includes a scenic walking exploration, followed by a delightful tasting session in an outdoor tasting room featuring prepared exotic fruits.

- 75–90-minute tour revealing the history of Grimal Grove
- Guided walking tour with opportunities to pick fruit (seasonal) 
- Outdoor tasting experience with a variety of exotic fruits 
- Learn about the 70+ years of restoration and resilience at the grove
